title: The Footprint Filling with Glitter Rain
youtube_title: The Footprint Filling with Glitter Rain | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Gita finds a footprint in garden soil filling with fine rain. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Gita shows Maren how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
